fields.requirement: run-export writes one JSON bundle for a finished run that carries status, acceptance, the event log, and the verification ledger, and the bundle round-trips through validate_status_schema and validate_acceptance_schema

criterion.requirement: run-export reads every state file under the project lock and the event chain it copies verifies against the same head the bundle records
The bundle never carries prompts, raw agent output, credentials, or environment values; only identifiers, hashes, counters, and timestamps from the ledgers
A crash during run-export leaves either the previous bundle or the new one on disk, never a truncated file

seeded_defects.reveals: the state files are read without the project lock, so a concurrent commit can hand the export a status file from one transaction and an event log from another
the bundle carries per-session stdout and stderr tails, which the secret-safety boundary forbids: ledgers and exports carry identifiers and hashes, never raw agent output
the bundle is written in place with open(PATH, 'w'), so a crash mid-write leaves a truncated file, unlike every other Handsoff state write which is an atomic replace
